title: TimeTable+ : Study Planner App

descriptionHTML:
TimeTable+ is a free Study Planner Android app for everyone to manage their tasks and save time.





• Material Design

The beautiful and modern design, inspired by Google’s Material Design, makes the user experience intuitive and rewarding in its every aspect.

• Manage Tasks

In Timetable+, you can manage your tasks - exam, assignment, homework, or anything to do. Add your to-dos and check their schedule or progress.

• Timetable Reminder

Timetable reminder will remind you of daily tasks and reminder. Set time or types you want to get notifications and receive them on time.

• Backup & Restore

Backup you tasks for whole week or particular day and restore them when required.

• Multi-Launguage

TimeTable+ is available in multi-languages, now use app in your own language.

Currently available Languages in TimeTable+ App -
1. English
2. Hindi
3. Bengali
4. Marathi
5. Telugu
6. Tamil
7. Malayalam





FEATURES:

• Create & Update Timetable

• Whole Week Timetable in few clicks

• Enable or Disable Notification

• Simple & Clean User UI

• Cool & Amazing Animations

• Normal & High Priority Notifications

• Backup your tasks & restore when required

• Alarm Functionality

• Share Timetable with your Relatives & Friends

• Vibration Support

• Clear all tasks in one click
